resident_1.name: Elena Park

rules.cites: Work return restores keys to the entry dish.

provenance.movement_reasoning: Elena’s entry items leave with her on museum and other trips and return to their assigned entry surfaces; kitchenware cycles through table, sink, rack, and cupboard; research materials linger at the dining table when work absorbs her, then tidy-up restores them. Reading and television move a small group around the sofa, while grooming, medication, bathing, laundry, and plant care keep their dedicated bedroom, bathroom, and kitchen objects in use.
provenance.persona_reasoning: A meticulous, commuting museum conservator who lives alone in a compact apartment and keeps a small, practical collection of objects. Her workday absences contrast with a deliberate home routine centered on reading, plant care, and cooking.
